title: Beat into Shape
description:
Deal 5 damage.
[gold]Forge[/gold] based on powered attacks dealt to this enemy this turn.
[gold]Forges[/gold] an additional 5 for every hit from this card.
upgraded_description:
Deal 7 damage.
[gold]Forge[/gold] based on powered attacks dealt to this enemy this turn.
[gold]Forges[/gold] an additional 7 for every hit from this card.
notes: Forge amount is calculated as the count of powered attacks dealt to the target this turn, then decremented by 5 (upgraded: 7) for each hit from this card's attack.
